posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Foote:

I am not as excited for VotM as I was for WotC. The Vengeance format just doesn't see a whole lot of table time with my group. Coupled with 0 new hero decks, i'm lukewarm towards this. Will I get it? Sure I will. Theres going to be too much amazing art and story from a whopping 10 villains. 10! Good god. 

That's one of the nice things I like about this: If folks don't feel like this set will see play, they don't have to buy it. And if there aren't enough pre-orders, it won't happen. This is great for >G, and avoids them wasting money on things that won't sell.

I'm hoping this set will get the folks I play with to get more into the Vengeance format. We have time to play it when we get together (as it does take a little longer to play), but it just hasn't caught on. (I should probably ask everyone why they don't want to play it. Really hoping it's the villain choices…)
